questions.question: What kind of patterns does Association Pattern Mining find among items?
questions.question_ar: ما نوع الأنماط التي يجدها تنقيب الأنماط الترابطية بين العناصر؟
options: itemsets whose items occur in a fixed order
co-occurrence patterns among items in a dataset
itemsets that appear in every transaction by definition
a rule's second part inferred from the antecedent
options_en: itemsets whose items occur in a fixed order
co-occurrence patterns among items in a dataset
itemsets that appear in every transaction by definition
a rule's second part inferred from the antecedent
options_ar: مجموعات العناصر التي تظهر عناصرها بترتيب ثابت
أنماط تزامن الظهور بين العناصر في مجموعة البيانات
مجموعات العناصر التي تظهر في كل معاملة بحكم التعريف
الجزء الثاني من القاعدة المستنتج من المقدمة
questions.explanation: Association Pattern Mining is a data mining technique used to discover interesting relationships, associations, or co-occurrence patterns among items in a dataset.
questions.explanation_ar: أنماط تزامن الظهور بين العناصر في مجموعة البيانات

questions.question_ar: ما المقصود بالعنصر في مثال مجموعة العناصر؟
options: a rule's second part inferred from the antecedent
a minimum-support threshold selected by a user
target-uncertainty patterns before observing a feature
individual elements, such as Bread, Milk, Coffee

a minimum-support threshold selected by a user

individual elements, such as Bread, Milk, Coffee

questions.question: How is an association rule commonly written?
questions.explanation: · These rules are expressed in the form of “If-Then” statements, typically written as {X} → {Y}, where X and Y are different sets of items.

questions.question: Which part of a rule is the antecedent?
questions.question_ar: أي جزء من القاعدة هو المقدمة؟
options: the first part of the rule, the condition
numerical-attribute patterns in a dataset
a collection of transactions with unique IDs
the second part inferred from the antecedent
options_en: the first part of the rule, the condition
numerical-attribute patterns in a dataset
a collection of transactions with unique IDs
the second part inferred from the antecedent
options_ar: الجزء الأول من القاعدة، أي الشرط
أنماط خصائص رقمية في مجموعة بيانات
مجموعة معاملات ذات معرفات فريدة
الجزء الثاني المستنتج من المقدمة
questions.explanation: Antecedent (X): This is the first part of the rule, the condition. It’s the set of items found in the database that you are examining for patterns. In the rule {X} →{Y}, X is the antecedent.
questions.explanation_ar: الجزء الأول من القاعدة، أي الشرط

questions.question: Which part of a rule is the consequent?
questions.question_ar: أي جزء من القاعدة هو النتيجة؟
options: the minimum-support threshold
the second part of the rule
the set of observed frequencies
the total number of transactions
options_en: the minimum-support threshold
the second part of the rule
the set of observed frequencies
the total number of transactions
options_ar: عتبة الحد الأدنى للدعم
الجزء الثاني من القاعدة
مجموعة التكرارات المشاهدة
العدد الكلي للمعاملات
questions.explanation: Consequent (Y): This is the second part of the rule, which is inferred from the presence of the antecedent in transactions. In the rule {X} →{Y}, Y is the consequent.
